title: SKELETON
author: Aakash Nayak
text:
There is a skeleton of a serpent
Covering itself with an ant-hill.
Inside are many small holes
in which ants are humming silently.
Slough, grains, tiny insects:
All are shining in the darkness of the skeleton.
In the mouth of an ant
Clusters of stars emerge.
Ant-hills melt down to its every crack.
In the swirl of sands, under the refuge of the skeleton,
the swarms of ants disapear.
In everybody`s mouth
the grains shine by the rays
Luminous, Luminous!
